Q8326.reason: Tall eunuchoid habitus, gynecomastia, small firm testes, and azoospermia are classic Klinefelter syndrome; karyotype confirms 47,XXY as the cause.

Q8328.reason: Asymptomatic bacteriuria in pregnancy (LE, WBCs, gram-negative rods, patient well) is treated with pregnancy-safe oral antibiotics such as amoxicillin; IV therapy is for pyelonephritis.

Q8330.reason: Hypothyroid features plus a diffusely enlarged nontender gland in an older woman is typical Hashimoto thyroiditis; biosynthetic defects present early and Graves causes hyperthyroidism.
